name: New Bark Area
description: The windswept eastern edge of Johto where the journey begins, spanning the routes around Cherrygrove City.

name: Violet Area
description: The rolling hills around Violet City, home to Sprout Tower, the Ruins of Alph, and Union Cave.

name: Azalea Area
description: The forested southwest around Azalea Town and Goldenrod City, including Ilex Forest and the National Park.

name: Ecruteak Area
description: The historic central routes surrounding Ecruteak City and the ruined Burned Tower.

name: Olivine Area
description: The western coast around Olivine and Cianwood Cities, dotted with sea routes, the Whirl Islands, and Mt. Mortar.

name: Mahogany Area
description: The cold northern highlands around Mahogany Town, the Lake of Rage, and the Ice Path.

name: Blackthorn Area
description: The remote mountains around Blackthorn City, including the Dragon's Den, Tohjo Falls, and Mt. Silver.
